reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common_contract.materiality: 26 individually reasoned directions:18 actual partial-use interfaces and8 scoped invalidation/enforcement-conflict interactions. This is no count target or Cartesian admission.
common_contract.reverse_rule: Every reverse has an independent consumed constraint, evidence return or actual enforcement mechanism.
common_contract.evidence_kinds: One prior finite C28 construction, five reasoned possible-context comparisons, actual native meanings and bounded source accounts; no current control execution.
common_contract.source_dependence: S039/S065 are one review and its date correction. S054/S055 review overlap is not quantified and is not pooled as independent trials. The closed S041/S042 publication extension clarification remains current; historical records remain unchanged.

directions.shared_object: A changed implementation and its preservation limits used at a real commitment decision.
directions.guard: An actual go, hold, redirect or stop decision consumes the structural candidate, remaining friction or configuration-specific evidence before a consequential commitment. Merely scheduling a refactoring meeting does not activate this interface.
directions.source_contribution: Identified changes, affected dependencies and bounded preservation or contrary evidence describe the realization on which the decision would rely.
directions.receiving_consequence: The review can reject stale readiness, narrow a proposed commitment or preserve a stop option while unsupported premises stay open.
directions.remaining_premises: The commitment, empowered actor, criteria and remaining risks are separate; a clean structure or green result does not create authority or prove overall readiness.
directions.positive_witness: V1/V2 have equal finite behavior but different identity; V3 has a known failed boundary. These are useful candidate-specific premises if an actual review consumes them. AC01 separates the technical fact from the commitment state.
directions.nontrigger_or_counterexample: Private reversible work with no such decision does not create a milestone need. A review that cannot change anything may consume a report without realizing the claimed decision property.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_removal: An existing result and asynchronous owned decision may suffice. Removing the current candidate correspondence loses that input; removing a duplicate meeting need not.
directions.reentry: Changed candidate, commitment consequence, review criteria or power to stop.

directions.shared_object: Actual structural-change facts and uncertainty used in a resource forecast.
directions.guard: An actual capacity, budget or commitment forecast uses identified change scope, dependency work, observed friction or preservation uncertainty from this codebase.
directions.source_contribution: The work exposes a real cost driver or revises an assumption about future change; a supported qualitative fact can matter before a numerical cost estimate exists.
directions.receiving_consequence: The forecast can widen a range, revise a scenario, include integration work or distinguish a target from an estimate.
directions.remaining_premises: Comparable data, effort measurements and uncertainty calibration remain separate. The number of source edits is not measured labor or a reliable savings ratio.
directions.positive_witness: C28 needs two direct comparison changes or one shared comparison, but the latter still affects two consumers and uses more source bytes. This invalidates a naive one-site equals one-unit-cost assumption rather than proving a cheaper project.

directions.cheap_alternative_and_removal: A short horizon forecast from actual work can suffice. Removing real scope data loses a forecast premise; a duplicate estimation workbook can disappear if that premise survives.
directions.reentry: New actuals, forecast horizon, dependency change or contrary estimate evidence.
